findings.text: First PLL control uses index zero with select bits zero to one, target bits two to twenty one, prescale bits twenty two to twenty three, gain bits twenty four to twenty six, counter bits twenty seven to twenty nine, mode bit thirty and bias bit thirty one, each field shifting by its lowest bit.
Low power reference is 20000000 and high throughput reference is 80000000.

Divider words use indices zero through five where zero holds four bit dividers at bits twenty to twenty three and twenty four to twenty seven, one holds an eight bit multiplier at bits zero to seven, two holds a twelve bit divider at bits twenty to thirty one, three holds a four bit rate at bits twenty eight to thirty one with a ratio flag at bit twenty seven and a fractional field at bits zero to twenty six, four is control and five uses bits zero to five for high divider. Generic control uses indices zero to five. Additional post divider uses bits twenty to twenty three and additional integer divider uses bits twenty to twenty eight. Management control is at zero with command data at four.

Options assign coexistence to bit zero, serial select to one, low noise to two, memory multiplex to three, amplifier enable to four, clock routing to five, management routing to six, amplifier routing to seven, auxiliary enable override to eight, auxiliary power override to nine, auxiliary enable to ten, pipe power to eleven and second amplifier to twelve, leaving thirteen to fifteen unused, with shutdown routes at sixteen and seventeen.

Toggle uses bit fifteen. Early drive for one family sets bits four to seven plus twenty to twenty three, later drive for the same family sets bits four to seven, and drive for the other family sets bits zero to two.

Chip control assigns amplification to fourteen, antenna to fifteen, flash to sixteen and audio groups to eighteen and nineteen with seventeen unused. Power resources assign bits zero to twenty nine in order to low dropout, sleep disable, bandgap, buck low power, buck pulse, core dropout, low voltage mode, wireless power, linear regulator, three volt regulator, one time memory, crystal, wireless switch, link quality, logic retention, memory sleep, MAC PHY retention, core readiness, idle request, low power availability, miscellaneous switch, synthesizer switch, receive switch, radio, oscillator regulator, front end regulator, receive regulator, transmit regulator, high throughput availability and MAC PHY clock availability.

Base tags are at zero, four, eight and twelve with parser at thirty two and length at thirty six. PHY access at two hundred fifty six carries payload bits zero to fifteen, address bits sixteen to twenty, register bits twenty four to twenty eight, direction at twenty nine and start at thirty. PHY control at two hundred sixty carries enable bits zero to four, timing bits sixteen to twenty two and mode at twenty three. RGMII control is at two hundred seventy two.

Filter access is at five hundred twelve. Content words run from five hundred twenty eight step four through five hundred fifty six. Mask words run from five hundred sixty step four through five hundred eighty eight. Action is at five hundred ninety two. Self test control is at six hundred seventy two with status at six hundred seventy six, compare at six hundred eighty, disable at six hundred eighty four and test at seven hundred fifty two.

User fields use sixteen byte groups each with three words spaced four apart starting at seven hundred sixty eight and continuing through nine hundred twelve, where the final group reuses nine hundred sixteen for two names showing shared storage.

Routing register at three thousand eight hundred forty eight packs four six bit selectors at bits zero to five, eight to thirteen, sixteen to twenty one and twenty four to twenty nine with shifts zero, eight, sixteen and twenty four.

Core control is at zero, exception base at four, self test at twelve, base interrupt mask at twenty with per line offset as line times four plus base, non maskable mask at forty four, GPIO select at sixty four with output at sixty eight and enable at seventy two, clock status at four hundred eighty, plus selectors at four and two hundred fifty six where offset four is shared with exception base.

Control at zero uses bits zero to three for reset enable, reset drive, clock enable and clock gate. Arbiter at sixteen uses bit zero for internal choice with bit one shared between external choice and low park bit, where park bits one to two encode last, local and two external agents. Status at thirty two and mask at thirty six each use bits zero to four for two attention lines, two errors and power event, with errors clearing on write in status.
Power state joins a backing device handle that may be shared or separate with a revision marker and an active crystal rate in kilohertz.

Parallel flash records presence only. Serial flash adds block size with block count and total size to presence. NAND flash places platform configuration first followed by presence and boot source flag, where leading placement enables outer container recovery.
Serial description joins a register base with clock speed, interrupt line, base baud divisor and register spacing shift.

Main state aggregates device handle, status with capability and extended capability, two single bit staged setup flags, fast power up delay, embedded power state, build selected flash members, build selected serial count with up to four ports, per millisecond tick factor, watchdog device, and GPIO lock with optional controller. Compact variant keeps only device handle with setup flag and mapped management base.
Ethernet common state joins a device handle with a PHY mutex. MIPS state joins a device handle with two single bit staged setup flags.
Chip common access provides device bound read and write by offset with variants that keep only masked bits, force chosen bits, or apply mask then set as one combined update.
Power access provides the same read, write, mask preserving, bit forcing and combined update shapes but bound to the embedded power device handle.
Ethernet common access provides sixteen and thirty two bit width specific read and write bound to its device handle and offset.
GPIO register traffic serializes on a spin lock in main state. PHY access and PHY control traffic serializes on a mutex in Ethernet common state.

Setup advances in stages tracked by single bit flags. Membership for flash kinds, serial ports and GPIO controller varies with build selection. NAND platform data must stay first to preserve container lookup.
Two user field names share one offset. Exception base shares its offset with one out of band selector. Park encoding shares its low bit with external arbiter selection.

Read modify write helpers use a separate read followed by write without internal atomicity, so concurrent updates to the same offset can lose bits unless callers hold the documented lock or otherwise serialize.
Each header uses a single definition symbol to prevent repeated processing within one translation unit.
